stories.title: Hyundai Motor India plans 45,000 crore EV investment
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India has filed its FY26 sustainability report, outlining a 45,000 crore capital expenditure plan for electrification and capacity expansion through FY30. The company achieved RE100 status with zero market-based Scope 2 emissions. The investment is intended to drive the company's transition toward electric vehicles.

stories.title: Marksans Pharma reports 100 percent export focus
stories.summary: Marksans Pharma has filed its FY26 sustainability report, disclosing a turnover of 1,341.47 crores with a 100 percent export contribution. The company reported no grievances regarding ethical or human rights issues. Governance is overseen by Chairman Mark Saldanha, and operations include zero liquid discharge mechanisms for environmental management.

stories.title: BPCL reports emissions drop and record ethanol blending
stories.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited filed its FY26 sustainability report, noting a 3.04 percent reduction in absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions. The company achieved 20 percent ethanol blending and reported a turnover of 5.22 lakh crore. The report highlights enhanced ESG ratings for the firm.

stories.title: ONGC disputes inadequate ESG rating
stories.summary: ONGC has formally disputed an Inadequate ESG score of 44 from ESGRisk.ai, calling the rating inconsistent with its sustainability efforts. The company's score fell from 48.54 in FY25 to 43.75 in FY26, following a 12.18-point deduction for safety incidents and regulatory penalties. The firm maintains its efforts are sufficient.

stories.title: ESAF Small Finance Bank files FY26 sustainability report
stories.summary: ESAF Small Finance Bank filed its FY26 sustainability report, disclosing a turnover of 43,48,23,07,824.57 and a net worth of 19,45,01,19,966.00. The bank operates 839 offices with 10,994 employees. It reported total energy consumption of 35,598.19 GJ and received limited assurance from M/s SustainedEDGE Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

stories.title: Avanti Feeds reports 54.8 percent renewable energy use
stories.summary: Avanti Feeds Limited filed its FY26 sustainability report, revealing that renewable energy accounted for 54.8 percent of its total energy consumption. The company reported zero workplace fatalities and 100 percent waste recovery. It aims to reach 50 percent sustainable procurement by the end of FY 2030.

stories.title: Acutaas Chemicals releases FY26 sustainability report
stories.summary: Acutaas Chemicals, formerly known as Ami Organics, has released its sustainability report for FY 2025-26. The document aligns with 2021 Global Reporting Initiative standards and structures the company's strategy around four key drivers, including health, technology, energy, and climate action. The report covers performance through March 2026.

stories.title: NTPC ESG score rises in SES assessment
stories.summary: NTPC has seen its ESG score upgraded to 64.6 by SES ESG Research Private Limited, based on FY 2025-26 data. This follows previous scores of 62.8 and 64.2. The upgrade reflects steady gains in the company's environmental, social, and governance performance over the last several years.

stories.title: Aavas Financiers ESG risk rating improves
stories.summary: Aavas Financiers disclosed that Morningstar Sustainalytics improved its ESG Risk Rating to 21.4 in 2026, down from 23.9 in 2025. The rating was assigned independently based on publicly available data. Under the methodology used, a lower numerical score indicates a reduction in assessed ESG-related risk.

stories.title: EU and UK near carbon market linkage deal
stories.summary: The European Union and the UK are in the final stages of a deal to link their emissions markets. The agreement would enable carbon permits to be traded across both systems, nearly six years after Britain started its own program. The treatment of financial derivatives remains the final issue.

stories.summary: China has launched a 599 million dollar green bond sale, according to a term sheet. The offering is part of the country's efforts to expand its offshore borrowing market and support sustainable projects. Further details on the sale are available for subscribers of the relevant financial news services.

stories.title: China green bond sale draws heavy demand
stories.summary: China attracted more than 40 billion yuan in orders for its first yuan-denominated green sovereign bond sale in Canada. The demand was approximately 10 times the planned offering of up to 4 billion yuan. Beijing is seeking to strengthen the international use of its currency.

stories.title: COP31 opens with leaders under pressure
stories.summary: The 31st UN climate conference has begun in Antalya, Turkey, with a focus on translating global climate commitments into concrete action. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned that the world has entered a new age of climate extremes. The summit agenda includes electrification and climate finance.

stories.title: Recycling alone is insufficient for resource security
stories.summary: Former European Environment Commissioner Janez Potočnik told the ISWA World Congress that recycling cannot deliver resource security on its own. He argued that governments must set specific targets for total material use to build resilient economies. Reducing demand for materials remains central to his proposed strategy.

stories.title: Leather industry seeks circular economy leadership
stories.summary: A new review in the journal Collagen and Leather argues the industry could lead in circularity if environmental claims are measured with greater rigor. The analysis highlights that existing life cycle assessment data often refuses to agree. The industry is currently mapping its own life cycle.

stories.title: Indonesia eyes circular economy for job growth
stories.summary: Indonesian Minister of Manpower Yassierli stated that the transition toward a circular economy will create millions of new jobs. The shift aims to replace linear industrial models with systems that optimize the reuse of raw materials. The government views waste elimination as a significant economic opportunity.

stories.title: Central PSUs pledge 2 trillion rupees for Uttar Pradesh energy
stories.summary: Central government public sector undertakings have pledged 2 trillion rupees for thermal and clean energy projects in Uttar Pradesh. Commitments include contributions from NTPC, Indian Oil, Coal India, and Bharat Petroleum. The state is currently looking for ways to spend the capital.

stories.title: GE Vernova to build 6GW transmission link for India
stories.summary: PowerGrid Corporation has appointed GE Vernova to deliver a 6GW high-voltage direct current transmission corridor between Rajasthan and South Kalamb. The 800kV link is designed to move renewable electricity from remote zones to the national network. The project includes building new converter stations.

stories.title: India projected to become second-largest renewable market
stories.summary: India was the fourth-largest renewable energy market in 2025 and is now third. The International Energy Agency expects the country to reach second place within five years, trailing only China. Falling prices and overcapacity elsewhere have made the region an alternative for global investors.

stories.title: CCI approves KKR-linked investment in Gentari Renewables India
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India has cleared Sapphire US HoldCo to subscribe to securities of Gentari Renewables India. The investment vehicle is managed by subsidiaries of KKR. Gentari is a subsidiary of Malaysia-based Petronas and operates renewable power and battery storage assets in India.

stories.title: India and Denmark discuss offshore wind and hydrogen
stories.summary: India and Denmark have held discussions to expand cooperation on offshore wind, green hydrogen, and grid integration. The meeting between ministers Martin Lidegaard and Pralhad Joshi took place during the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit. The two nations are currently marking a 30-year partnership.

stories.title: IEA forecasts 530GW of renewable capacity by 2030
stories.summary: The International Energy Agency projects India will reach 530GW of renewable capacity by 2030. Solar power is expected to account for 80 percent of the expansion, with total capacity crossing 300GW in late 2026. The country is now the world's second-largest renewable growth market.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI weather prediction models are released with 32-bit (fp32) weights and run in fp32 by default, although current GPUs compute much faster in 16-bit formats. We run five publicly available models -- Aurora, Pangu-Weather, FourCastNet, SFNO. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Hidden climate superpower: Why some ocean “snow” carries six times more carbon
research.summary: Scientists have discovered that the stickiness of underwater “marine snow” plays a surprisingly important role in how much carbon reaches the deep ocean. Gooier particles resist bacterial breakdown and can transport more than six times as much carbon to the depths, revealing an unexpected connection between ocean slime.

research.title: RainFlow: Flow Matching for Infrared-Only Quantitative Precipitation Estimation
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Geostationary infrared imagers observe precipitating systems every 10 to 15 minutes over large areas, but they sense cloud tops rather than the rain beneath. Their brightness temperatures constrain surface rain only weakly, so retrievals trained by. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Raytracing and quantifying the inferior mirage
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Using custom raytracing code, we explore several features of the inferior mirage that are not widely discussed, such as the blurring in the mirage image, and what happens to the light in the direct image region. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Reconciling advective upwelling with diapycnal downwelling: A transient kinematic perspective on Munk's conundrum
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bottom-intensified turbulent fluxes observed near the seafloor drive abyssal densification and diapycnal downwelling through their vertical divergence. This appears paradoxical under steady stratification because dense bottom waters continuously enter from Antarctic sources. Motivated by evolving Indo-Pacific. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Sensitivity of the IceCube atmospheric muon rate to decadal trends in the effective atmospheric temperature
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Decadal changes in the Antarctic stratosphere, generally associated with ozone recovery and shifts in polar circulation, are of broad geophysical interest. However, independent long-term measurements of the atmosphere above the Antarctic interior are scarce. We assess. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: The Re-Foundation of Radar Meteorology
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Since the early development of radar meteorology in the 1940s, rainfall retrieval has traditionally relied on empirical scaling relationships between radar variables and rainfall rate. Here, we revisit the premise that horizontal and differential reflectivity sufficiently. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
